{{Top|leg}}
A '''slime-bug''' was a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base [[DVL-181]] was located. Slime-bugs were known to get into dinners made on the base.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
